summary: Iteration 29 — backend-only regression for the mobile blink-only + no-auto-logout session. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_blink_regression.py (8 tests). Results: 7 passed, 1 skipped. Auth regression fully green: owner login, employee login (role=employee), /auth/me for owner (role=org_owner, org_id/org_name/id present), /auth/refresh rotates both access_token and refresh_token. Selfie liveness: LIVENESS_ACTIONS constant asserted == ['blink'] via source read; the admin POST /api/sessions/challenge-now/{user_id} live-path check was SKIPPED because the seeded employee currently has no active session and one cannot be safely bootstrapped from the API without geofence/photo scaffolding — documented as acceptable per the review request. Respond endpoint contract: POST /api/sessions/challenge/{id}/respond returns 4xx (422 on missing/short face_photo via Pydantic; 404 on unknown challenge id with a valid-length payload) — never 500. Employee has no face baseline so the 400 'Liveness check required' branch is not enforced for that account (documented behavior).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sessions.py:55 LIVENESS_ACTIONS=['blink'] is now the single source of truth — both random.choice sites (~219 manual challenge, ~1124 admin challenge-now) pick 'blink' deterministically. Good.

respond_challenge still requires liveness_frame+liveness_action only when face_baseline is enrolled AND settings.active_liveness=True AND ACTIVE_LIVENESS_ENFORCE is set. Since the test employee has no baseline, the 400 contract path for missing liveness fields cannot be exercised on that account — a dedicated seeded 'faced' employee would enable full HTTP coverage here (unit tests already cover this in test_active_liveness_iter28.py).

Small nit unchanged from iter28: respond endpoint should short-circuit the contract check above save_session_photo (already the case now at line ~575, before save_session_photo at ~586). Confirmed on re-read — fine.

action_label map in respond_challenge (~628) still lists turn_left/turn_right labels though those actions are no longer picked. Dead-but-safe branch; consider trimming to blink-only messaging to reduce confusion for future maintainers.
